# Nordic biogas nutrient return dataset gaps

## Scope and evidence rules

This is a bounded dataset for **Denmark, Finland, Norway and Iceland only**. Sweden is not re-audited here because you supplied the baseline. I have kept a hard distinction between **produced digestate/biorest volumes** and **realised nutrient return**. Energy production, gas upgrading, or generic claims that biogas is “circular” are **not** counted as nutrient circularity unless a source documents that digestate/biorest/sludge is actually used on land and, ideally, quantifies the returned nutrients. citeturn32search0turn15search1turn14search0

Evidence classes used below are: **fact-primary**, **fact-official-secondary**, **inference**, **not found**, and **excluded**. For Denmark, Finland and Iceland, the main finding is the absence of public national N/P/K return totals. For Norway, there is a stronger partial dataset on biorest output and agricultural use share, but not national N/P/K return. citeturn36view0turn41view1turn23view0turn31view0

### Short cross-country judgement

| Country | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Denmark | **needs-primary-check** | Reporting obligations exist, but I did not locate a public national digestate tonnage table or realised N/P/K return dataset. citeturn33search6turn36view0 |
| Finland | **needs-data** | Official survey appears comprehensive, but public aggregate digestate and realised N/P/K output tables were not located. citeturn41view1turn41view2 |
| Norway | **needs-primary-check** | Best partial dataset found: produced biorest tonnage plus agricultural spreading share. National realised N/P/K return is still missing. citeturn23view0turn22view1 |
| Iceland | **needs-data** | Only operator-level nutrient-return evidence located; no national digestate/N/P/K dataset located. citeturn31view0turn26search1 |

| Country | Figure | Treatment | Why excluded |
|---|---|---|---|
| Iceland | GAJA page says it received “22 tonnes” of food scraps in 2024 citeturn31view0 | **excluded** | This is inconsistent with SORPA’s own official 2023 statement that residents sorted about **10,500 tonnes** of food scraps, and with the scale of GAJA operations. I treat the “22 tonnes” line as a probable typo or truncation and do **not** use it quantitatively. citeturn31view0turn28search3 |

**Bottom line:** for the user’s exact gap question — **realised nutrient return from biogas/digestate in DK, FI, NO, IS** — only **Norway** yields a usable partial national dataset from the sources located here, and even that stops at **biorest mass plus land-spreading share**, not **tonnes of N/P/K returned**. Denmark, Finland and Iceland remain predominantly **blank-cell findings**, which is itself the main result. citeturn23view0turn36view0turn41view1turn31view0
